pre_fix_etw_capture.dwm_tir_message: Forced multisampling with an attachment is unsupported

interpretation: Explorer WinUI XAML Islands failed on two combined tgd3d defects introduced on 2026-11-19: (1) Device::hasA8 was hardcoded false without VK_KHR_maintenance5 and runtime_shared_tiled_validate rejected D3D11.1 shared DXGI_FORMAT_A8_UNORM textures, triggering a 119x DEVICEREMOVED recreation loop; (2) unconditional D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_1 caused DWM/D2D to emit attachment-bound TIR draws dropped by tgd3d/NVK. Enabling VK_KHR_maintenance5 + native VK_FORMAT_A8_UNORM, allowing D3D11.1 non-displayable tiled shared A8_UNORM/R8_UNORM, and gating FL11_1 behind TGD3D_FL11_1_APPLICATION=1 eliminates all failures.
